1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is __intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __wherein the multivalent cation crosslinker is selected from zirconium, aluminum, titanium, chromium, or iron compounds__.

3) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4) (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5) (Cancelled)

6) (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

7) (Cancelled)

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of __less than 100 nm__ in diameter.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __and wherein the polyalkylenimine molecular weight is between 500 Da and 1500 Da__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyalkylenimine is less than 2000 Da and said nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker__.

12) (Cancelled)

13) (Cancelled)

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1 __wherein the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker__; b) a polymer __having anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Cancelled)

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said fluid is __seawater or field brine__.
